summary: A heat pump can very likely heat this house with the existing heating system at <= 55 C.

reasons.text: Underfloor heating works at low flow temperatures (around 35 C).

technician_checks: Outdoor unit placement, sound and permits
assumptions: Full-load hours 1800-2100 h (official approx. 2,000; range ours)
Hot-water share of the bill uncertain (unknown or solar thermal): subtract 0 to full per-person amount
Other heat source in use: the bill misses part of the demand, area method used alone
Underfloor heating: flow temperature around 35 C (official)
Heat pump also covers hot water, at the same JAZ as space heating
